rows.grounds: compound denoting the gathering or observance of dharma

items.question: At what time must the collection of dharma be properly undertaken?
premises: The collection of dharma is an obligatory duty.
This duty is qualified by a specific timing.
The timing is expressed as being appropriate or proper.
items.inference: Therefore, the collection of dharma must be performed at the proper time.
uncertainties: The precise scope of dharma+saṃgraha in this context is not specified.
items.plain_english: The collection of dharma should be carried out at the proper time.
